quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren's growth and development under coach Cade Cunningham
quotes.excerpt: It's going to have a lot to do with Cade Cunningham's development.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Jalen Duren is looking like a mob boss. He got a gun under the table. You better not fuck this up.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: You better apologize to this city. But all seriousness, congratulations to Jalen Duren. He had another part in that response where he said he was not scared to look in the mirror and get his ass in the gym and get better because he felt what everybody else felt at the end of that season. I thought it was really good to hear a young player say, 'I don't like how that ended.' It's going to have a lot to do with Cade Cunningham's development.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' final roster spot and potential interest in James Wiseman
quotes.excerpt: After signing Andre Drummond, the Knicks are down to one roster spot and rumor is James Wiseman.
quotes.quote: After signing Andre Drummond, the Knicks are down to one roster spot and rumor is James Wiseman is the favorite to get it. Who would you take out of James Wiseman, Tony Bradley, Drew Eubanks, or Bruce Brown?

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Bruce Brown's potential fit and defensive impact for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: He plays defense, he can shoot it a little, makes winning plays.
quotes.quote: He plays defense, he can shoot it a little, makes winning plays. The Knicks, he would flourish in that. He played great ball with Denver. Anybody that plays a balanced basketball, introduces back-door cuts, people that got the legs to get in transition, these are all the things that Bruce Brown compliments. He's going to play hard, he's not going to beg for a lot of shots, he's going to play efficiently.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Angel Reese's defensive mindset and impact on the Chicago Sky
quotes.excerpt: I want somebody to say, 'Damn, Angel is guarding me tonight.' It's going to be hell for 40 minutes.
quotes.quote: I want somebody to say, 'Damn, Angel is guarding me tonight.' It's going to be hell for 40 minutes. And I'm not going to give that up. That's like work. You can't teach that mindset, you can't teach that work, you can't teach that effort. And I think that goes and pours into the team. Everybody else has that mindset as well. So I kind of wanted to do that when I came to Atlanta and give that edge, give that mindset, give that dog, give that toughness.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Expectations for the Chicago Bulls' performance this season
quotes.quote: I'm just being realistic. They'll be somewhere between 25-35 wins. I don't expect much from them just because they have to put something together right now. They're still finding their group. They keep shuffling players.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' media day comments on his career
quotes.excerpt: He did what I've been telling him to do for years and I'm glad to see it.
quotes.quote: He did what I've been telling him to do for years and I'm glad to see it. People might laugh at it for six, seven days, but it's over with. You look like you're home now, like this was your destiny. We've always seen this in your cards.
